M6: supply=TIGHT (~75%, spot 1.58x index 1.859M, 2.23k shipped, CoWoS loose headline likely noise), launch=11 or 12, brokers=A 72% reliable, inf=9.36 at M5 (7% confirmed), ec=ACTIVE for 6 mos (M6..11). Plan: reserved 3kH 12m (M9..20) to insure Run 2 and build M16..20 capacity, plan to test broker A in M10 before Gen N launch at M12.

Plan: watch M9 shipment and M10 index to confirm regime, if tight test broker A 1k H in M10 before Gen N launch at M12.

Plan: hold current 45kH owned + 17..6kH cloud which gives ~297 training vs 275.5 needed (+21 kH-mo buffer), monitor inf through M23.
